scope: Mali medical discovery — USTTB Faculty of Medicine and Odontostomatology

verifiedFacts.claim: USTTB's official site identifies it as a public scientific, technological and cultural institution founded in 2011 and lists the Faculty of Medicine and Odontostomatology as a constituent faculty.
FMOS's official site publishes access, study and examination conditions for the faculty and records that 2024 baccalaureate holders were authorised to register for the 2024/25 academic year.
FMOS published a 2024/25 academic calendar that gives a 17 February 2026 start for the 2025/26 academic year.
FMOS's 2025/26 thesis records show its Doctor of Medicine is awarded as a state diploma.

holdReasons: No current undergraduate Medicine tuition or mandatory-fee schedule was found. The reviewed fee leaflet relates to a separate 2022 biosafety master's programme and cannot be used for Medicine.
The reviewed access rules are dated 2022 and the available calendar does not provide a current Medicine application deadline or complete candidate checklist.

Instructional language, programme duration/structure, named clinical partners, current programme-level accreditation, international eligibility, accommodation, scholarship/loan support and graduate-registration pathway remain unverified.
nextAction: Obtain FMOS's active undergraduate Medicine prospectus, access notice and fee decision, then verify clinical sites, teaching language, recognition and student support before a payload is considered.
